articles.title: Democrats killed the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: Democrats should remember the people they represent and do what's best for them, not what's best for their political calculus, consultants, and special interests, writes Sen. Tim Scott (R-S.C.).

articles.title: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
articles.snippet: The new software lets companies add custom security checks so they do not fall victim to the same type of vulnerabilities that plagued rival bridges.

articles.title: Kakaopay partners with Dinari, Ondo to explore tokenized Korean stocks
articles.snippet: Kakaopay Securities is working with Dinari and Ondo Finance to explore tokenizing Korean-listed equities and expanding their availability to investors in international markets.

articles.title: Bitget CEO says $388M hack exploited third-party security vulnerability
articles.snippet: Some stolen assets have been frozen, but Bitget has yet to disclose how much has been recovered as investigators continue to assess a possible North Korea link.

articles.title: California Bans Public Officials From Issuing Meme Coins Under New Newsom Law
articles.snippet: Governor Gavin Newsom’s legislation bars public officials from issuing meme coins and exchanges from listing tokens tied to politicians.
